answer.explanation: UploaderFunction fails on every invocation in the window (roughly 40 invocations, each ending in an ERROR) with NoSuchBucket on S3 PutObject. The error means the target bucket does not exist, not that access is denied, so IAM is unlikely. The bucket name comes from OUTPUT_BUCKET, so the most likely cause is a misconfigured or missing bucket name in the function's environment, with the IaC template as the place it originates. The other functions (CrudApi, Thumbnailer, Compression) complete normally. No tool outputs were available, so this conclusion rests on the log evidence alone.
